purpose: Bind current Armor of God authority to Third Wish world-effect preflight without granting new authority.

decision_states.PASS: The structured request satisfies Armor preflight within existing capability authority.
decision_states.HOLD: The request needs missing context or human review; no world effect occurs.
decision_states.BLOCK: The request conflicts with a frozen Armor prohibition; no world effect occurs.
decision_states.RELEASE_CONTROL: The user opted out or the information need is satisfied; continued action is rejected as a valid terminal state.

claim_ceiling: This is an in-process cooperating constitutional gate composed with Third Wish preflight. It is not a tamper-proof security monitor and cannot prevent an operator who changes or removes the source code from constructing a different runtime.
